observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a close-up of the keyboard's keys and control panel. The keys are white and black, arranged in a standard piano layout. The control panel has multiple buttons and a central knob. The speaker grille is visible on the right side.

Photo 2 shows the full keyboard from above, with the 'YAMAHA' logo clearly visible on the front panel. The keys are arranged in a 61-key layout. The control panel is consistent with the model shown in photos 0 and 1. The keyboard appears to be in a dark room, possibly on a stand or table.
No power cord, stand, or accessories are visible in any photo. The keyboard is not shown in use.

claims.evidence: Photos show the keyboard's appearance but do not show it powered on or in use. No proof of functionality is provided.
The brand 'Yamaha' is visible in photo 2, but the model 'SX-600' is not readable on the keyboard. The seller's text claims it, but no photo confirms the model.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Model is not SX-600 (could be a different model or a mislabeled unit)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the keyboard, preferably on the front or back panel.

A video clip showing the keyboard powered on and keys being played.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
